scope: official-current-source verification for five registered GlobalSaaSHub tools after cross-checking latest.json for existing individual application/result records

terms.commission: 25%-35% recurring revenue share for up to 12 months
terms.payout: PayPal or Stripe; referrals are verified and paid within 60 days after the referred trial starts

terms.commission: up to USD 150 per qualified Basic/Grow/Advanced full-price plan referral; exact amount varies by referred merchant location
terms.cookie: 30 days from click; if the referral starts a free trial, conversion tracking can continue for up to 400 days
terms.signup: free; applications are reviewed, generally within 5 business days
terms.payout: Impact; minimum withdrawal balance USD 10, with bank account or PayPal supported

results.eligibility_note: Official guidance prioritizes applicants with an active website, established audience, original commerce/entrepreneurship content, and relevant ecommerce experience. No application was submitted during the audit.

terms.commission: 50% revenue share on a qualified new user's first subscription for up to 12 months; higher tiers can add 10%-15% revenue share for up to 12 additional months after renewal
terms.signup: application and approval required; intended for content creators, influencers, educators, bloggers, software reviewers, and others with a digital audience
terms.program_exclusivity: cannot participate in both the Webflow Affiliate Program and Webflow Partner Program

results.safety_note: The current application requires confirming that the applicant has read and understood program terms. Do not auto-consent; stop for user approval if the later application batch reaches that legal agreement step.

terms.commission: 10% of first-year contract value per qualifying enterprise client, capped at EUR 500 per deal
terms.payout: within 30 days after deal close, by invoice
terms.target_partner: HR tech consultants, staffing group owners, TA advisors, or others with direct relationships to enterprise recruitment/staffing organizations

results.eligibility_note: Official requirements call for strong relationships with enterprise staffing/recruitment organizations in the European or US market, trusted-advisor status, and willingness to make warm introductions. Do not submit automatically until COSHUMA's fit against these requirements is confirmed.

terms.commission: 30% commission on every qualified referral; official page describes a recurring-revenue model
terms.signup: free and open via the official affiliate registration flow
terms.target_partner: blogs, newsletters, YouTube channels, LinkedIn/career communities, and publishers with an audience of job seekers

results.verification_note: The current public official page does not expose a reliable cookie duration or payout threshold in the indexed content, so those fields are intentionally left unasserted.

dedupe_rule: Existing individual application/result records override research-only classifications. Shared partner programs must not be applied to more than once. Already-completed UUIDs must not be recreated.
